title: Story: nominal, gain shift, AAC engaged
caption: One continuous flight: nominal, then a gain shift the detector catches, then the AAC suppresses it.

regimeCaptions.nominal: Nominal: the slosh oscillation slowly decays. Try a Kick to excite it.
regimeCaptions.gainShift: Gain shift: the slosh oscillation is now growing; the detector is watching.
regimeCaptions.engaged: AAC engaged: K_T is lowered and the oscillation stops growing and decays.
